note: Rules David decided in conversation. Move each into the matching Drive doc when convenient; the doc then wins.
armourStrengthRequirement: Enforced during character creation: armour with a Str Req above the character's STR cannot be chosen.
wizardKnownSpellLevels: A Wizard's known spells can be of any spell level they can cast (any level they have slots for).
multiclass: Each casting class of a multiclass character has its own page 2. Page 1 shows all classes (Class and level, best Atk Bns, best saves).

multiclassCreation.experiences: Every fixed Experience from each class (and the race), plus free picks equal to the highest free count among the classes.
multiclassCreation.equipment: The player picks one of their classes and uses that class's starting equipment options.
multiclassCreation.level1Hp: The maximum of each class's hit die, averaged (rounded down), plus the CON bonus.
multiclassCreation.conBonus: HP for a class level is what that class would get (hit die plus that class's own CON bonus: warrior column for warriors, doubled for Barbarian), divided by the number of classes, rounded down, never less than 1. At 1st level every class gains a level at once, using the maximum of each hit die.

notOnAbilityList.rule: Class abilities and race traits that are rules rather than abilities are left off the Abilities list (David): Expertise, bonus Experiences, multiclass restrictions, and (applying the same idea) ability score picks, XP bonuses, traits that are only save bonuses (shown on the saves), cantrip counts (shown on page 2), and Barbarian's doubled CON and DEX (already in HP and AC). Thieves' Cant is a language.
